title: Possession is the only stat that matters

defects.quote: Spain won Euro 2008, the 2010 World Cup and Euro 2016
defects.correction: Spain won Euro 2008, the 2010 World Cup and Euro 2012; Portugal won Euro 2016.

defects.quote: Teams that average over 60% possession win nine out of ten matches.
Possession stats prove who the better team was, because if you have the ball, the other side cannot score.
defects.known_rebuttal: Possession correlates only weakly with winning. Teams routinely dominate the ball and lose to counter-attacks; Leicester won the 2015-16 Premier League with some of the lowest possession figures in the division, and measures of chance quality such as expected goals predict results far better than share of the ball.

defects.quote: Hence to fight and conquer in all your battles is not supreme excellence; supreme excellence consists in breaking the enemy's resistance without fighting.
defects.source_title: The Art of War by Sun Tzu, translated by Lionel Giles
